title: ChatConfirmationPromptBlock
description: Lightweight assistant confirmation prompt for yes/no style acknowledgement. This is conversational confirmation only and is distinct from approval workflows.

questionId.description: Stable prompt identifier used to correlate responses.

prompt.description: Confirmation question shown to the user.

confirmLabel.description: Optional label for the affirmative action.

cancelLabel.description: Optional label for the negative action.
